text:
maria gonzalez: Quick heads-up — scheduling a maintenance window in eu-west1 to address intermittent scheduler memory spikes causing OOM kills. Thu 02:00–05:00 UTC. We'll do livepatching + one-by-one node reboots on the scheduler/gpu-control plane.
ajay singh: ETA on when the notice goes out to customers? need to sync with support pages.
maria gonzalez: support pinged. public status page update will go 12h before. internal pager for Dedicated customers sent now.
sylvie: What parts will be drained? only scheduler/controlplane VMs or also GPU nodes?
maria gonzalez: Primary targets: 4 scheduler replicas + 2 control-plane nodes. We will cordon scheduler nodes and restart them. No planned GPU node reboots unless we see KV cache leaks during the test.
chris barker: If scheduler pods get evicted, batch inference backfills could spike. Can we pre-bump capacity for hosted-api pool for that hour?
maria gonzalez: yes we can spin up +2 backfill pools in eu-west1 for the window. ajay — can you approve the temporary capacity bump (cost ~ $120/hr)?
ajay singh: approved for the window. Put cost on ENG-ops-ephemeral charge.
ops_oncall: Note: some Private customers are pinned to eu-west1 and cannot failover. We'll annotate those and do a targeted graceful drain for any pinned tenants.
maria gonzalez: good call — we'll build an exclude list from tenant pins and skip eviction for those nodes. Ops, please post the list by EOD.
infra-bot: deploybot: scheduled job created: "eu-w1-scheduler-livepatch-2165432100" starts Thu 02:00 UTC. See runbook: https://intranet.redwood/ops/playbooks/livepatch-scheduler
sylvie: how about traffic routing? if scheduler latency jumps, should we route new requests to us-west temporarily? data residency concerns for Private customers though.
chris barker: Routing policy already has fallback to us-west but excludes pinned private tenants. For hosted, we'll shift 10% of new traffic to us-west as canary, then 30% if stable.
ajay singh: add a 5m steady-state check at +10% and +30% steps, auto-rollback on error rate > 1.5x baseline.
maria gonzalez: ops_oncall — please run the preflight checklist: \n```
kubectl cordon scheduler-01
kubectl drain scheduler-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
# run livepatch, verify memory metric returns below 70% within 5m
kubectl uncordon scheduler-01
```
ops_oncall: running smoke load tests against model-serving after each node comes back. Will report telemetry in #eng-sre.
sylvie: any expected 429s on API? need to warn downstream teams.
maria gonzalez: brief 429 blips possible during eviction windows. We'll throttle client retries and set a 30s retry-after.
chris barker: once done, let's also run a quick cost analysis — bumping pools + failover traffic are small but worth capturing for postmortem.
ajay singh: agree. I'll create ticket INF-4220 to capture costs and results.
infra-bot: incidentbot: reminder — create post-maintenance incident note within 2 hours after window ends.
maria gonzalez: thanks all. I'll post final attendee list and exclude-tenants tomorrow. :thumbsup:
